issues.description: Unsupported-delimiter ValueError is undocumented in the Raises clause
issues.detail: The new delimiter precondition raises a raw ValueError when the value is not in _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS, but the docstring's Raises section only lists HTTPBadRequest. Callers cannot anticipate this exception from the spec. Either document the ValueError explicitly or validate at a layer that converts it to HTTPBadRequest so the contract matches reality.

issues.description: Delimiter silently no-ops when the value is already a list from multiple instances
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times, items arrives as a list and the delimiter branch is skipped, weakening the documented postcondition. A caller passing delimiter='|' expects splitting regardless of upstream parsing. Either re-split list elements uniformly or reject the combination explicitly; today the behavior is surprising and untested in combination with transform.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates symbolic style names and literal delimiter characters in one namespace
issues.detail: The mapping mixes OpenAPI symbolic names ('pipeDelimited') with literal characters ('|') as keys. This muddies the contract and risks future silent collisions (e.g., adding 'p' as a delimiter). A typed enum, Literal union, or two small frozensets would name the alias explicitly and read more honestly.

issues.description: Missing test pinning default-path behavior when delimiter is unset or param is absent
issues.detail: No test asserts that calling get_param_as_list without delimiter on a comma-containing value (auto_parse_qs_csv False) returns a single-element list, nor that delimiter set with a missing param still returns the default. Both lock the opt-in contract cheaply and prevent regressions on the unchanged default path.

issues.description: Blank/empty-token behavior after split is undefined and untested
issues.detail: It is unclear what get_param_as_list('x', delimiter=',') returns for 'x=a,,b' — ['a','','b'] or filtered. The docstring notes keep_blank_qs_values has no effect on secondary splitting but no test pins the actual behavior. One test would prevent future maintainers from guessing.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small, well-scoped opt-in feature with reasonable shape — one method, one new kwarg, overloads and news fragment included, basic happy-path tests present. Two P1 contract issues dominate: the unsupported-delimiter ValueError is not declared in the Raises clause, and the delimiter argument silently no-ops when the value is already a list, weakening the documented postcondition. Secondary concerns are taste/abstraction: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates symbolic style names with literal characters, and tests do not pin default-path or blank-token behavior. NEEDS-WORK on contract documentation and a few targeted tests; lands after that.
